title: Buffered I/O
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of buffered i/o and identify when it is appropriate in a Java program.
Apply at least one of the lesson topics—bufferedinputstream—in a small, readable example.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study buffered i/o with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you read and write local data while handling resources, paths, and malformed input safely. In this lesson, focus on bufferedinputstream and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Treat console input as untrusted text. Validate format and range before using it, account for token-versus-line reading, and give users a clear way to correct invalid input. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.

content_blocks.title: How the pieces fit
content_blocks.text: Connect bufferedinputstream with bufferedoutputstream before choosing an implementation. The example is a small, observable case; extend it by changing one input and checking a boundary, invalid value, or compatibility limit where relevant.

items.title: BufferedInputStream
items.text: Treat console input as untrusted text. Validate format and range before using it, account for token-versus-line reading, and give users a clear way to correct invalid input.

items.title: BufferedOutputStream
items.text: A stream pipeline describes transformations over a source. Intermediate operations are lazy; a terminal operation triggers work, and stream instances should not be reused after a terminal operation.

items.title: BufferedReader
items.text: Treat console input as untrusted text. Validate format and range before using it, account for token-versus-line reading, and give users a clear way to correct invalid input.

content_blocks.title: Professional habit
content_blocks.text: Keep one clear hypothesis per experiment. Check the version, read the error message, test boundaries, and record what evidence supports your conclusion.
